title: Bless Ewbank Gagliasso makes his debut in a soap opera
subtitle: Son of Giovanna Ewbank and Bruno Gagliasso makes his debut in soap operas
excerpt: Bless Ewbank Gagliasso, son of Giovanna Ewbank and Bruno Gagliasso, debuts in The Nobility of Love
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The son of Giovanna Ewbank and Bruno Gagliasso, Bless, will make his debut in soap operas in The Nobility of Love. He recorded flashback sequences as Cayman II, a character played by Welket Bungué, and will appear in scenes set in the past of Batanga.

Bless' role in The Nobility of Love

Bless' scenes are scheduled to air in the chapter of The Nobility of Love this Friday, 2, in which José (Bukassa Kabengele) will return to Batanga on a secret mission. Disguised, the prince will tour the surroundings of the palace where he grew up until he reaches the location of the sacred baobab.

Giovanna Ewbank's reaction

Giovanna Ewbank revealed that the decision to pursue an artistic career came from her son. "Seeing Bless there by his own choice, doing something he loves and that makes his eyes shine was beautiful. Now it's his turn to live this story. Ours is to be around, supporting and cheering him on," she said.

Bless' artistic career

Bless also takes theater classes and has already participated in the feature film Makunaima XXI, which has no release date yet. "He's always had an artistic soul. He's a sensitive boy who likes music, painting, drawing, singing, and acting. Art has always been a very natural way for him to express himself.

Parental support

Bruno and I have always been very careful to make our children feel free to discover their own paths. So, when this desire came, we respected and supported it," the actress added.

With information from O GLOBO, Estadão, VEJA.
